examples.name: Default
examples.summary: The docs chrome around an article: section links and search in the sticky header, the docs tree with the theme switch at its foot, the article in the slot with headings tracked by the On this page rail, a call to action under the rail and the footer under the article. The document scrolls; the header and both rails stay in view.

examples.name: Persisted rail
examples.summary: The navigation rail resized by dragging its edge (or the arrow keys on its handle) and collapsed from the button at its foot, with v-model:navigation-open and v-model:navigation-width saved to local storage so the rail keeps its size and state across reloads.
